_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done: Make a sound effect from a description
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoking: Make a sound effect from a description...

description: Use this when someone needs a UI, game or motion-design sound effect: a click, a notification ding, a whoosh, a coin pickup, a riser or a logo sting. Pass the person's own words as describe ('a short soft click for a toggle', 'deep whoosh for a scene cut'), one call per sound, or an id from list_sounds. Words such as high, deep, short, long, bright or muffled tweak the sound; pitch, length and brightness set it exactly. Returns the best match named by the Universal Category System (UCS), a WAV link, a Web Audio function named after the sound, such as playCoinPickup(), that plays the same sound (give code exactly as returned; several sounds can share one script), a UCS file name and close alternatives. Everything is CC0. status no_match lists the categories to rephrase with.

examples.describe: a short soft click for a toggle

brightness.description: Brightness factor for the filters: below 1 is darker, above 1 is brighter

describe.description: The sound in plain words, such as 'a short soft click for a toggle' or 'deep whoosh for a scene cut'

id.description: An id from list_sounds or an earlier answer, instead of describe

length.description: Length factor: 0.5 is half as long, 2 is twice as long

pitch.description: Pitch shift in semitones; overrides words such as 'high' or 'deep'

name: make_sound

cat_id.description: UCS CatID, such as UIClick or DSGNWhsh

category.description: UCS category the CatID stands for, such as USER INTERFACE

description.description: What the sound is, in one sentence

id.description: Stable id of the sound; pass it back as id to get its code

name.description: Short name, as in the UCS FXName

page_url.description: The sound on the free web page, where a person can play it

subcategory.description: UCS subcategory the CatID stands for, such as CLICK

wav_url.description: Link to the rendered WAV, 44.1 kHz 16-bit mono

categories.description: On no_match: the UCS categories the vocabulary covers, to rephrase with

describe.description: The description that was matched; null when an id was passed

license.description: The license of the sound, the WAV and the code

matched_words.description: Words of the description that chose the sound

code.description: A self-contained JavaScript function, named play_function, that plays the same sound with the Web Audio API

description.description: What the sound is, in one sentence

duration_s.description: Length of the WAV in seconds

filename.description: A UCS file name to save the WAV as: CatID_FXName_CreatorID_SourceID.wav

name.description: Short name, as in the UCS FXName

page_url.description: The sound on the free web page

title: Make a sound effect from a description
